gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.063126 38.932122)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
slope_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(s.rast, 1, o.pt) AS slope_degrees
FROM slope_rast s, origin o;

WITH twin_oaks_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM pois
  WHERE id = 6698
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast, 
        true, 
        twin_oaks.geom
      ), 
      1, 
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r, twin_oaks_geom twin_oaks
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, twin_oaks.geom)
)
SELECT 
  ST_Stats(slope_rast).mean AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM slope_raster s;
